topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include adaptive frequency allocation, rate-splitting multiple access, and beamforming. These methods mitigate interference by dynamically assigning frequencies, decoding common messages, and optimizing spatial selectivity. Machine learning can further enhance beamforming patterns, improving spectral efficiency without increasing complexity.
reference_context: Polarization correlation coefficients and geographic coverage data inform interference mitigation strategies in SatCom and RF Engineering.
